title: Full CAC Lifecycle
description: End-to-end Crimes Against Children modeling: hotline/CyberTip intake, grooming or trafficking conduct, CSAM forensic provenance, rescue, task-force coordination, and legal outcomes. Anchors every class to the CAC semantic spine.
mission: Give LE and child-protection teams — and the agents that assist them — one profile that selects the right CAC modules, Facet sets, and spine kinds so children can be identified, located, and safeguarded faster.

RasterPicture.notes: CSAM artifacts are RasterPicture (or File) observables, never a CAC class standing in for the bytes.

recipe_skeleton.summary: CACInvestigation + spine-typed roles/events/phases + hashed media + legal outcomes.
steps: Create CACInvestigation (not a bare Investigation) when the case is CAC.
Anchor people as PersonLikeEntity + Role (ChildVictim, OnlinePredator, …). Never type the person as the role.
Model conduct as ExploitationEvent / GroomingBehavior with Phase progression.
Model intake as hotline/NCMECCybertipReport (Situation/Event as declared by the module).
Model media as RasterPicture + HashIntelligence Facet set; record ForensicAcquisitionAction and EvidenceVerificationAction separately.
Model rescue / task force / charges with the matching CAC modules.
